mechanism: Indomethacin (NSAID) reduces renal blood flow and may impair renal function, potentially increasing minocycline levels and toxicity risk; minocycline may increase intracranial pressure when combined with NSAIDs.
action: Monitor renal function and for signs of minocycline toxicity; consider alternative NSAID or analgesic if possible, especially in patients with baseline renal impairment.
